notes.title: Tri6: Infinite 1.7.0
notes.content:
After a long time without any updates here we are with a new small one!

The new Tri6: Infinite update isn’t big, but it adjusts two things that got mentioned by you. The first one adjusts the volume of the engine sound of Hyperion compared to the other vehicles. The second change stops AI from using the movement inversion power-up. That’s because it was a kinda random and almost always an instant death for the player.

[h1]Full changelog[/h1]
[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]adjusted volume of Hyperion engine sounds
[*]disabled movement inversion for bots
[/list]

tags.balance_change: adjusted volume of Hyperion engine sounds

notes.title: Tri6: Infinite 1.6.1
notes.content:
A new Tri6: Infinite update is out adding proper Steam Deck support and adding the soundtrack as free DLC on Steam.

As a little christmas present we have a small new update for Tri6: Infinite for you today. It contains a few small fixes mostly related to Steam Deck and some bonus electrons for defeating virus vehicles.

But that’s not all! As already mentioned, we now officially support Steam Deck. We did some thorough testing as we have one now and fixed a few issues here and there and you can now expect to play without any serious issues. To be fair, it wasn’t really an issue before this update, but there were a few clipping issues for example.

And as a special christmas gift we launched the soundtrack as free DLC on Steam now. So you can just check it out even without owning the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215070/Tri6_Infinite_Soundtrack/

[h1]Full changelog[/h1]
[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]defeating viruses gives some electrons as well now
[*]controller prompts automatically enabled on Steam Deck now
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed OSK on aspect ratios < 16:9 (e.g. Steam Deck)
[*]fixed clipping issue with some fields on some platforms
[/list]

tags.feature: defeating viruses gives some electrons as well now
controller prompts automatically enabled on Steam Deck now

tags.bug: fixed OSK on aspect ratios < 16:9 (e.g. Steam Deck)
fixed clipping issue with some fields on some platforms

notes.title: Tri6: Infinite 1.6.0
notes.content:
A new Tri6: Infinite patch is now available with some bugfixes and improvements to celebrate the game expanding to more platforms.

The new patch slightly improves the graphics quality by improving the post processing, adds controller vibration also on PC and fixes several bugs all over the place.

If you want to try out the game first, you can download our free demo via Steam.

As we are working on the concept of its successor, feel free to share any feedback you have so we can make it even better!

[h1]Full changelog[/h1]
[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]slightly improved post processing
[*]added gamepad vibration on collision also on non-PS4 platforms
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed game hang on PS4 opening PS overlay while starting the game
[*]fixed ramp exploit
[*]fixed rare issue where vehicle could clip through the sorrounding walls
[*]fixed rare issue where colliding before next lap led to an empty track
[*]fixed random network connection popups
[*]fixed game not being paused when losing focus
[*]fixed mute setting not being stored properly
[*]fixed continue option not working when in settings menu after being in input settings sub menu
[*]fixed B/Circle button not being selectable for button mapping
[*]fixed controller movement controls only working when set to either left or right stick
[*]fixed players 2-4 having wrong default color when joining
[*]fixed one gamepad and keyboard not being able to play together properly
[*]fixed controller disconnect not being hinted and game continueing to run
[*]fixed render issue on 3 players splitscreen
[/list]

notes.title: Tri6: Infinite 1.5.2
notes.content:
A new Tri6: Infinite patch is now available with some bugfixes for issues we found in the last months.

Today we release a new patch for Tri6: Infinite on all platforms. The update fixes a few bugs, some like the not updating UI after unlock and the animated UI elements being paused when opening the menu from ingame affect all platforms, others only affect some versions.

If you want to try out the game first, you can download our free demo via Steam.

[h1]Full changelog[/h1]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]resolution not properly restored from settings
[*]fixed game hang when restarting game between collision and finish screen
[*]fixed navigation using Q/E being possible while in key assignment overlay
[*]fixed changing controller type as player 1 not updating UI when keyboard is selected as default device
[*]fixed unlocking unlockables without being logged in not updating UI
[*]fixed animated UI elements stopping when opening menu from ingame
[*]fixed wrong icon being displayed to unlock an unlockable using controller
[/list]

notes.title: Tri6: Infinite 1.5.1
notes.content:
Today we release an update with small fixes and improvements for Tri6: Infinite.

During our time in console cerifications and discussions we fixed several small issues that we or the console vendors found. This also includes a crash fix when switching from multiplayer to singleplayer and a lock-up when pressing LB/RB while in the loading screen. A new feature we introduced is that the selected vehicle color now is stored per vehicle and not globally anymore. Now it behaves like the skin selection.

If you want to try out the game first, you can download our free demo via Steam.

[h1]Full changelog[/h1]
[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]added feature to report inappropriate content
[*]added password mode to onscreen keyboard
[*]color now is stored per vehicle
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed hang when pressing shortcut to navigate through tabs during loading screen
[*]fixed password reset not working when trying to enter e-mail address
[*]fixed random sound bug when spawning virus
[*]fixed fade in after collision while a skin is activated
[*]fixed rare render issue when changing track
[*]fixed navigation bug after login
[*]Shock Wave sometimes stays on the map
[*]reduced volume of Virus sound
[*]fixed (potential) crash switching from multiplayer to singleplayer
[*]slightly improved start camera sequence
[/list]

notes.title: Tri6: Infinite 1.5.0
notes.content:
The fifth and last content update brings you the new “Elemental War” skin set for all three vehicles.

Today we released the fifth skin set for Tri6: Infinite. It’s the Elemental War set you can see in the trailer below. The new skins can also be unlocked for 250 electrons each. The Hermes skin is also available in the demo.

[previewyoutube=6C3VidBrE00;full][/previewyoutube]

This is the last skin set we will release. Tri6: Infinite is finished now from our side and will only get bugfixes if necessary.

If you want to try out the game first, you can download our free demo via Steam.

[h1]Full changelog[/h1]
[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]added skin set “Elemental War”
[/list]

notes.title: Tri6: Infinite 1.3.0
notes.content:
The third content update brings you the new “Gravity Vector” skin set for all three vehicles together with three small bugfixes.

Today we released the third skin set for Tri6: Infinite. It’s the Gravity Vector set you can see in the trailer below. The new skins can also be unlocked for 250 electrons each. The Hermes skin is also available in the demo.

[previewyoutube=1j_mOKc600M;full][/previewyoutube]

The bugfixes are related to obstacles and one to splitscreen, which had bug that could lead to the game hanging up on the loadscreen.

If you want to try out the game first, you can download our free demo via Steam.

[h1]Full changelog[/h1]
[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*]added skin set “Gravity Vector”
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed lasers destroying vehicle even when shield is active
[*]made a later obstacle easier that was close to impossible with Helios
[*]fixed potential error when starting game multiple times
[/list]

The next update will contain the next skin set. The console ports now are almost done and we’re in the final test stage to ensure everything works fine on every platform. Together with the last skin set (#5) we plan to submit the console versions for review. So just two weeks left!

notes.title: Tri6: Infinite 1.1.0
notes.content:
The first content update after release contains the first skin set we call “Digital Noise” for all three vehicles together with some small improvements.

Our plan is to release a new skin set every week until we have five skins per vehicle additional to the exclusive ones you can get via SCILL Play, 4Players and 4Players Pur. The first skin set in this series is the Digital Noise skin set you can now unlock ingame for 250 electrons for each vehicle, so to unlock all three of them you need 750 electrons.

You can check out the new skins ingame before purchasing them for your collected electrons or in our new trailer featuring them:

[previewyoutube=LDf_EuSoHwI;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to try out the game first, you can download our free demo via Steam.

[h1]Full changelog[/h1]
[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] added a first skin set
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed dissolve effect when using a skin
[*] fixed stuttering of vehicles in curves
[*] fixed vehicles sometimes rising from ground when steering pretty hard from one direction into the other one
[/list]

Until the next update we will add the second skin set and continue working on the console ports. The latter look pretty good so far, it’s more or less just a matter of testing.
